reviews.text: Excellent and friendly service
Extremely satisfied and excellent follow-up on the animal's condition. The vet and technician were top-notch.
Great service,all staff are very kind and friendly
Excellent follow-up for our pet Pixel. They keep us informed of the best options, recommend avenues to explore, and provide follow-up phone calls.
Caring, lovely staff. My dog is not a fan but I am!

Superb clinic, attentive, flexible, and incredibly friendly. Veterinarian Victoria Tremblay is very patient and gentle with our dog, who is very afraid of vet visits. She finds solutions and adapts readily. Thank you, Dr. Tremblay!

Best veterinary experience ever. I highly recommend them!

Warm welcome, honest and caring veterinarian. Care with follow-up on the animal's condition; impeccable service.

Professionals who truly care about the health of animals. I thank the entire team for their exceptional work!
Very professional. Friendly and unfriendly staff.
Beautiful place and fantastic staff

We're new clients for our cat, but we already felt confident after just one appointment. Communication and service were incredibly fast. The staff was attentive and very kind, and we were pleasantly surprised by the price.
So glad to have a veterinary clinic like this in our neighborhood!
Thank you to the whole team!
The staff know how to put my cat and me at ease!

Wow, I was so surprised by this clinic. Compared to others I've been to, the approach is so different! They work at the pace of both the animal and the owner!

Thank you!
Impeccable and empathetic service for my Merlot until the end of his life! I've kept the same clinic for my redhead, Baboune. Thank you for everything!

Why did the receptionist tell me to come pick up the second treatment, Maya's syringe, on August 4th? If they're closed, had I known, I would have taken two syringes for the ticks... It's really not cool.
Veterinarian Veronik Auger is logical and attentive to the animals' symptoms. No unnecessary examinations or overmedication. Thank you from Pandah. :)

Four years ago, I moved to the area and started buying my cat's food there. I already noticed the excellent service. Today, my cat has been sick for several days, so I asked if I could see a vet quickly, and they rushed to find me a spot immediately to help. Two hours later, I had the diagnosis and medication, along with follow-up insurance. - WOW! I'm blown away!!! :D We love our furry companions so much... and it shows that they love us too. :)
The best for miles around! Impeccable service and meticulous follow-up. Warm atmosphere. My dog ​​always wants to go say hello!
Highly professional and great quality medical staff and assistance. Their store is also top class. My cat is handled with great care here...highly recommend 🔥🔥 …
Excellent service! I needed to see them quickly, and during a multi-day snowstorm, they managed to find me not one but two last-minute appointments :)
Incredible team 🩷 They offered caring support during both the medical care and sudden loss of my dear cat …
The vet was very kind and professional. She didn't try to sell us unnecessary services, as one might fear at the vet or dentist!
The staff are empathetic, caring, and professional. They genuinely care about the well-being of our animals. I never felt pressured. I highly recommend them.
Knowledgeable and understanding staff! Cute and clean atmosphere. I loved the level of care they gave to my special 17 year old lady 😺 …

No one is like Dr Auger and her team
Can’t recommend enough!!
Helpful and obliging staff, a very nice team.

A beautiful clinic with a wonderful staff. I love the logo drawn by the owner's children. The receptionist Simone (and her beautiful dog Claude) are incredibly welcoming. I highly recommend it for your pets.
I never give perfect scores, but if I could give 4.5, I would!
This is one of the few clinics that prioritizes the well-being of its patients. The staff is truly welcoming, and the service is extremely professional.

My dog ​​had surgery at this clinic, and although I returned a few days later because the wound wasn't healing properly, I had to go to the Montreal Veterinary Centre (emergency room) over the weekend.

I wrote to the clinic to explain my disappointment, but I never received a reply. Furthermore, I didn't see a single veterinarian, either after the surgery or during my second visit.
For these reasons, I do not recommend this clinic.
I have my 2 cats registered here and every time I visit or have a consultation, the service was great. The receptionist and the veterinarians are helpful and friendly.
